Usage: resecta-data build zip-scf [OPTIONS]

  Build the ZIP → SCF → state table from a HUD crosswalk CSV.

Options:
  --source FILE          Path to the HUD ZIP-to-state crosswalk CSV.  [required]
  --build-dir DIRECTORY  [required]
  --retrieval-date TEXT  ISO date the source was fetched (YYYY-MM-DD). Must match SOURCES.md.
                         [required]
  --seed INTEGER         [default: 20260416]
  --help                 Show this message and exit.
